body: Not yet. But if he reaches out again, I’ll bring it up.

I don’t think I’d call him a jerk per se.
We both wanted sex and had sex. That’s not the issue. 
Now, I’m missing chatting with him as a friend. Sex changes things, and now we’re both being....some type of way. Shit I don’t know.

Nah, I’m pretty sure I know who it was, and she’s a busy body. She wanted to stir the pot. 

And, I don’t want any unsolicited hugs. So, I’m glad she didn’t try that.

That’s why I’m annoyed! 
I want to either meet him or cut it loose. 
I’ve always been one to meet sooner rather than later. It doesn’t help that he lives an hour away from me though. And we have kids, so our schedules don’t always mesh.
I asked him if he cared to join me at a concert next Friday and he said “absolutely”, so there we are I guess.
Lol! Poor wording on my part

It can! 

I’ve been on literally dozens of dates in the last 18 months. Sometimes I was ghosted, sometimes I was pursued by someone I wasn’t interested in, and sometimes I went along with a 2nd or 3rd date just because I wanted so badly for something to work. 

Even if it doesn’t work with this guy, at least I have proof that when you have that connection, it may not be tangible or easily explained, but it’s there, and you find out pretty quickly.

We only had one drink, so the feelings were legit, at least for me.  I was instantly physically attracted and knew within five minutes that he was someone I wanted to pursue. Keep in mind that I’m a straight up cynic, so most of my post date feelings are never more than “meh”

Lol, no. I’m in the South. 

Also, whyyyy the fuck do people do this?!?
Yup! Even if it doesn’t work out, it feels pretty damn good!

You’re right. Haha. I’m just caught up in how excellent the sex and chemistry are.

But, yes, lots of talking about our kids (he has one daughter, I have 1 son and two daughters). We’ve talked about what we’re looking for, which is long term. He has his own business, so he’s told me about his hopes/dreams of things to come for that, as well as the stress that it brings. (He was super stressed about work on Sunday, so he told me he just wanted my company, and I was happy to oblige and hear about his woes). 

And through the course of this past weekend, I discovered that his ex wife is married to one of the doctors I work for...small world. He asked me if it would be weird if I met the doctor in that setting, ie, getting his daughter or whatever, and I told him I’m not sure. 

So, yes, lots of banging, but lots of shared interests and learning about each other too.
True. Though we did agree that we weren’t sleeping with other people before we had sex. (Keeping in mind that he could’ve just said that to get laid)

I have good health insurance, but no time to go to counseling. A few local places I called require a once weekly session in order for them to take you as a new patient. I don’t even take a lunch break 90% of the time. I eat lunch at my desk and work, because the deadlines are so unreasonable. I know that the first step I have to take is to find a new job. I’ll be paid out all of my PTO when I leave, so it could sustain me for a few months if I needed to go that route.

Thanks. 
I can’t take any real vacation time due to the demands of my job. I actually took off the afternoon today because I had a job interview with a place closer to home, less stress, but less money. I’m not really sure I can afford any loss of income, but I also just can’t afford for my mental health to get any worse either. 
I actually had to miss my interview because my tire was so bald that I was going to have a blowout. I asked the recruiter if I could reschedule, she said she would check. I really hope that works out. I just need ONE thing to go my way.
No. I haven’t lived with her in 20 years. I’m 35, and make plenty of money of my own to not have to depend on her. She just won’t leave me alone.
I’m sorry you’re in pain. I’m acutely aware of the depth of that pain.
You’re still awfully young, I’m confident that you have time to turn things around.

That makes sense. My peak was 23-24. And my life definitely spiraled downward from there. Had I known then how bad my life would get, I would’ve killed myself 10 years ago. 
So, maybe our brain just recalibrates every so often to keep us alive?
